generalInfo.templeDescription: Mahakaleshwar (Mahakal) is the Jyotirlinga shrine at Ujjain dedicated to Lord Shiva. The lingam is believed to be swayambhu and the idol is Dakshinamurti (faces south). The temple complex spreads over five levels (one underground) and shows Maratha, Bhumija and Chalukya architectural influences; notable features include a carved shikhara, intricately carved pillars and ornate ceilings. The sanctum contains images of Ganesh (west), Parvati (north), and Kartikeya (east) with Nandi to the south; the idol of Omkareshwar Shiva is consecrated above the Mahakal shrine. The idol of Nagchandreshwar on the third storey is accessible for darshan only on Nag Panchami. The site is famed for the unique daily Bhasma Aarti during which the Shivlingam is adorned with a silver crown, serpent, jewels and holy ash. The temple has a long recorded history including reconstruction in the 12th century and later renovations in the 18th century.
generalInfo.deity: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga (Lord Shiva; Mahakal; idol is Dakshinamurti facing south)
generalInfo.dressCode: Garbh Grah Darshan: Men - dhoti; Women - saree. For Bhasma Aarti: Men - dhoti with upper body bare; Women - saree.

aartis.name: Bhasma Aarti
aartis.extraInfo: Unique daily ritual at Mahakaleshwar; Shivlingam is adorned with a silver crown, serpent, jewels and holy ash. It is the only Jyotirlinga temple known to perform the Bhasma Aarti. Participation requires prior booking; photography inside the sanctum during the aarti is strictly prohibited.

transportation.extraInfo: Nearest major airport for Ujjain (Indore airport is commonly used).
Ujjain is a railway station on the Western Railway zone (station code UJN).
Regular bus services and road connections link Ujjain with Indore, Bhopal, Ratlam, Gwalior, Mandu, Dhar, Kota and Omkareshwar.

nearbyPlaces.name: Harsiddhi Mata Temple
nearbyPlaces.description: Shakti shrine near Rudra Sagar Lake in Ujjain; approximately 600 metres from Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga. Temple opens 05:00 AM–07:00 PM and celebrates Navratri with extended timings.
